How do I use it properly the very first time?
Using your meat for the first time is very simple! Here are the best practices for unpacking, defrosting, and cooking:
• Unpacking & Storage: When your box arrives, unpack the vacuum-sealed packages and place them directly into your freezer. If any dry ice remains in the box, avoid touching it with bare hands and let it evaporate in a well-ventilated area.
ASK OUR AI ASSISTANT
• Defrosting (Refrigerator Method): Transfer the vacuum-sealed cut to your refrigerator 1 to 2 days before cooking (or 2 to 3 days for larger roasts). Once defrosted, cook within 2 to 3 days.
